summary: Best 27.975 (95 valid evals): warm incumbent + --race-ratchet + --respawn-novel + fast unstuck heating; the greedy policy flies the human's CP2 detour (D-ramp ride at ~1,800 u/s, climb to slot height) and dies at the slot's narrow end. Found the CP2 anatomy (analysis only: low exit, curved D-ramp ride, ~220 u slot; tools/fail_probe.py) and, with CPU won't/can't probes, that the ride is a skill to practise. Under the stock potential, policy-guided Go-Explore spawns (tools/ge_spawns.py + explore_phase1 rooted at the policy's own frontier) improved the ride but never crossed in 2.4B steps (27.4-27.54); --respawn-novel alone and the new --spawn-burst (continuous view, deepest-reservoir gate) were flat. The ratchet is the enabler (r1b1/r1b2 found it first); an over-trained lineage + ratchet did not cross, fresh from the incumbent did in ~300M steps. At T 2 the route comes and goes; T<=1 loses it. Next: stabilise the route (SIL on route episodes, a T schedule that consolidates after an eval gain), then the slot's west end and the corridor to CP2 (30.9%).
